name: launchers-launcher
description: Full-screen, controller-driven kiosk launcher for a KDE/Wayland living-room PC (Steam / Heroic / RetroArch) with HDMI-CEC TV mode.

scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.lint:shell: npx --yes shellcheck@4.1.0 -S warning -x bin/*.sh install.sh get-launchers-launcher.sh $(ls tools/*.sh 2>/dev/null) .githooks/*
scripts.setup-hooks: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
